subject.title: fix(feishu): preserve text before media attachments

question: Should this PR wait for redacted after-fix Feishu text-plus-media proof, and should its shared block-delivery acknowledgement change stay in this branch?
rationale: The affected behavior is user-visible channel delivery, and the branch now touches both Feishu-specific ordering and shared reply fallback semantics that tests alone do not prove in a real Feishu conversation.

options.title: Require proof and review shared scope
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu client proof showing final text plus image delivery and review the shared block-delivery change before merge.

options.title: Feishu-only landing path
options.body: Keep only the Feishu dispatcher repair here and split the shared block-delivery acknowledgement change into a separate core reply PR.

options.title: Use sibling branch
options.body: If https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102399 becomes the selected proof-positive landing path, close this PR as superseded then.

recommendation.title: Require proof and review shared scope
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Feishu client proof showing final text plus image delivery and review the shared block-delivery change before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu community maintainer, making them the best available owner for Feishu proof sufficiency.
